artifacts_produced.deploy_evidence: Source only; no deploy is in this cell's scope. S19: reads a Bronze envelope through an injected bronze_reader(), types every business cell per business_scalar_schema, serializes a typed parquet table (BUSINESS_COLUMNS + ROW_METADATA_FIELDS, 10 columns), stamps every envelope field except rows plus Bronze address/response_sha256/snapshot_id lineage as file metadata, and persists through a SilverStore at the ONE address()-computed key (_silver_key).

17 tests (test_ac1_ .. test_ac11_, one or more per criterion), synthetic Bronze envelopes and LocalSilverStore only -- no live route, no Graph, no S3SilverStore construction (checked by test_no_live_route_or_s3_call_site_is_executed_in_this_test_module). py -3.12 -m pytest ... -q: 17 passed in 0.5s.

The probe for all 11 criteria: each AC runs its named pytest subset in a fresh subprocess (never in-process), requires rc 0 AND at least one test collected (a 0-of-0 run is a refused vacuous pass), and prints exactly one VERDICT line. Mirrors the TX-b-1 probe's structure (same repo, same pattern).
This order's result record: every value with its instrument, UTC time and denominator; it rides the commit that carries this instance.
